caption: The drawing depicts a single blue glass bottle with a spherical body and a short neck, centered on a plain, light beige background. The bottle has vertical ribbed grooves running from top to bottom, giving it a textured appearance. A raised band encircles the midsection, bearing embossed text that reads "GARDEN HAND GR" (with some letters obscured). On the front of the bottle, within the band, there is a five-pointed star and the word "STAR" clearly visible in the center. The overall color of the bottle is a range of blue hues, with shading to suggest reflection and transparency typical of glass, and there is a brownish tone inside the neck opening. In the bottom right corner of the image, there is a small signature reading "L. S. MARKINSON K.G.C.M.O.I." The composition is minimalist, with the bottle as the only object, and no additional elements or background details are present.
title: Fire Extinguisher
